pairs.title: Turkish lira in US dollars
pairs.description: How many US dollars TRY 100 buys. A rising number means a stronger Turkish lira. Starts in 2005, with the new lira of 2005; earlier years are in older currency units.
pairs.source: World Bank series PA.NUS.FCRF · official exchange rate, annual average, shown as 100 ÷ the published TRY per US$.
